events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, billed as '3 Days of Peace & Music,' took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, the legendary Woodstock Festival kicked off, bringing together half a million people for three days of peace, music, and counter-culture. What a moment in history!

events.title: Elvis Presley Tribute
events.blurb: August 16th marks the anniversary of the passing of the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who died in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: On this day in 1977, we lost a true legend. Remembering the one and only Elvis Presley, whose music and impact continue to resonate across generations.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' iconic frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: From 'Brass in Pocket' to 'Don't Get Me Wrong', Chrissie Hynde has been a rock icon for decades. Wishing The Pretenders' legendary singer a very happy 75th birthday!

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher is 54 today! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger after all these years. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated globally as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab a martini (shaken, not stirred) and celebrate James Bond Day! We're marking the anniversary of the first 007 film premiere. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles' legendary co-founder, John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're remembering the extraordinary life and timeless music of John Lennon. Imagine the impact he had.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, John Cleese, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: From silly walks to classic comedy, wishing the brilliant John Cleese a very happy 87th birthday! What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Tribute
events.blurb: November 24th marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, the music world lost an irreplaceable talent. Remembering the incredible Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain legendary.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-nine years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly changed the game. What's your favourite track from this masterpiece?
